## Summary
Mothilal M is a Software Engineer and Python Developer based in India (Dharmapuri, Tamil Nadu & Hyderabad, Telangana). He specializes in scalable backend systems, FastAPI microservices, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure, Docker containerization, and distributed database architectures.

- **Backend Frameworks**: FastAPI, Starlette, Pydantic, Node.js

- **Databases & Caching**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Database Design & Optimization
- **Architecture**: Microservices, RESTful API design, Asynchronous Programming, High-Availability Systems
- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Responsive UI/UX
